message: I was once the proud owner of enough canned beans to start my own small grocery store. When a storm was forecasted, I turned into the gloriously over-prepared person, stocking up on every non-perishable I could find. My family rolled their eyes as I filled the pantry, but when the power went out and the winds howled, they were more than happy to dig into my little treasure trove of snacks. I guess it’s true what they say: better safe than sorry! How do you prep for storms?
